args.title: Bellwether Office: Retail Returns Logistics — Summary
args.body:
Combined summary of the Bellwether Office newsletter, its linked article, and the companion piece:

• Newsletter (from newsletter@bellwether.example): This week's topic is retail returns logistics, pointing to a feature article at blog.bellwether.example and a free-registration companion piece on insights.bellwether.example.
• Article (blog.bellwether.example/2026/returns): Apparel return rates have reached 24%, and consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth (~20%).
• Companion piece (insights.bellwether.example/returns/companion, registered with owen.brandt@northwind.example): Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
